user_query: I want to design creative invitations for a costume party, suggest playful fonts, provide a random tone, analyze sentiment of the description, and get the lemma text.

TaskList.description: Fetch a list of playful fonts suitable for costume party invitations.
Generate a random tone that matches the festive theme of the costume party.
Analyze the sentiment of the provided party description: 'Get ready for a night of fun and laughter'.
Obtain the lemma text of the party description for further analysis.
